items.question: Who is the system designed for?
items.answer: Raqamli Bozor is designed for market management, inspectors and staff who keep rental records.

items.question: Can it work with existing cameras?
items.answer: Compatibility with existing cameras is checked during the demo. Required connections and equipment are agreed with you.

items.question: How much does implementation cost?
items.answer: The price depends on the features, equipment and amount of work required. During the demo we define your needs and agree on the price.

items.question: How long does it take to launch the system?
items.answer: The timeline depends on the required connections and scope of work. During the demo we draw up a rollout plan and agree on the timeline with you.

oferta.title: Public offer
oferta.description: Terms of use of Raqamli Bozor services.

sections.heading: 1. General provisions
paragraphs: This document sets out the terms on which RealSoft (hereinafter the “Contractor”) provides the Raqamli Bozor system services.
The Customer is deemed to have accepted these terms when submitting a demo request or starting to use the service.

sections.heading: 2. Subject of the service
paragraphs: Raqamli Bozor is a digital market management system: stall occupancy, payment control, rent records, parking and camera analytics, and reports.
The exact scope, term and price of the service are set out in a separate contract or appendix between the parties.

sections.heading: 3. Demo and rollout
paragraphs: The demo is free of charge and creates no obligation. During rollout, the compatibility of existing equipment (including cameras) with the system is checked.

sections.heading: 4. Obligations of the parties
paragraphs: The Contractor provides the service in the agreed scope and quality and ensures the confidentiality of data.
The Customer provides accurate information, does not pass access rights to third parties and makes the agreed payments on time.

sections.heading: 5. Liability
paragraphs: The parties are liable for failure to perform their obligations in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan. The Contractor is not liable for interruptions in third-party services.

sections.heading: 6. Final provisions
paragraphs: The Contractor reserves the right to change these terms; a new version takes effect once published on the website. Disputes are resolved by negotiation and, failing agreement, in the manner prescribed by law.

maxfiylik.title: Privacy policy
maxfiylik.description: How personal data is collected and protected on the Raqamli Bozor website.

sections.heading: 1. What data is collected
paragraphs: The phone number you enter in the contact form is stored, along with the page the request was sent from and the time. No other personal data is requested.

sections.heading: 2. What it is used for
paragraphs: The data is used only to contact you, provide a demo and advise you about the service.

sections.heading: 3. Storage and protection
paragraphs: Phone numbers are stored in a closed system and can be seen only by authorised staff. The data is not placed in public repositories and is not sold or passed to third parties, except as provided by law.
To protect against spam, the IP address may be used temporarily for rate limiting.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The site does not use advertising cookies that are not necessary for its basic operation.

sections.heading: 5. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to obtain information about your data and to ask for it to be corrected or deleted. To do so, contact us via realsoft.uz.

sections.heading: 6. Changes
paragraphs: If the policy is updated, the new version is published on this page and the date is updated.
